title: A whole gate run leaves entries in its TMPDIR: update-notice stamps, release_git_remote's files from calls killed at their bound, and Node's compile cache
body:
Filed for devbin 0.1.27's batch (vc's decision 205, which carries vc's todo 214), from dc's todo 67 of 2026-11-13.

## What happened

dc ran `bin/devbin release gates` (check all, test all, doctor) on a Desk slot in a fresh clone at 3c804a37 on 2026-11-13, 11:25:57Z to 11:43:16Z by date -u, and it was green. TMPDIR was shaped as a leg's, an empty directory beside the tree. After the run, the top of that TMPDIR held 18 entries: update-notice stamps, `devbin-git.*` files and `node-compile-cache`. The record is ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-dc/g24/run-g24.out ("TMPDIR after: 18 entries") and the seal pair in g24/seals/3c804a37. The names beyond those three kinds were not kept, and that TMPDIR is gone.

## The code

- The update notice keeps its stamp in TMPDIR by design (devbin_update_notice, lib/helpers:6906-6931: "The stamp lives in TMPDIR rather than the project, so it needs no .gitignore entry"). It writes one only when stderr is a terminal (:6910), and each project root has a stamp of its own name (:6914), so the stamps come from arms that run bin/devbin with stderr on a terminal.
- release_git_remote takes git's stderr into `mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/devbin-git.XXXXXX"` and removes it after the call, but "A call killed at its bound (release_run_bounded) prints none of what it said and leaves its file under TMPDIR" (lib/release.steps:847-851). Each arm that kills a remote call at its bound leaves one.
- `node-compile-cache` is Node's own module cache, under the TMPDIR of a Node tool that ran. bin/.devbin/config.yaml names no Node tool.

On a leg host the gates' TMPDIR is the run's own, <worktree>.tmp, and goes with the worktree (lib/release.legs:222-228). A cut's local leg runs in place with this machine's TMPDIR, so what a run leaves there stays until the OS clears it.

## Not yet known

- The other entries' names. One gate run that lists its TMPDIR after would say.
- Which Node tool wrote node-compile-cache.

## Options, none chosen

- A killed call's file goes with the call: the bounded run removes it, or the file lives in a directory its caller removes whatever happens.
- The suite gives each arm a TMPDIR of its own, so nothing an arm runs reaches the run's.
- Keep the stamps as designed, one small file per project for a day, and say so.

## Resolution

cc, 2026-11-17 19:30Z by date -u: fixed by unit 0368-1, landed at a21916fc for 0.1.27, from 9a07c35a, stacked on 0369-1 and tested at its tip. The first two options, with the third kept. release_run_bounded (lib/release.steps) makes each call a TMPDIR of its own under its caller's, devbin-call.XXXXXX, runs the call's process group with TMPDIR set to it, and once the call has ended, the deadline's kill included, makes it writable and removes it, warning if it cannot. So a killed remote call's devbin-git.* file goes with the call, in a cut as in the suite. No caller reads a file under TMPDIR once a call returns: release_git_remote, the cut's calls (lib/cmd/release's cut_call_rc and attach_call) and release_wait read only the out and err files they named. devbin_setup (tests/lib/test_helper.bash) gives each test a TMPDIR of its own, devbin-tmp.XXXXXX, beside its DEVBIN_TEST_TMPDIR, and devbin_teardown removes it under the same guard. A test that sets TMPDIR itself still does. The update notice keeps its stamp in TMPDIR as designed, and on a person's terminal that is one small file per project a day; under the suite the stamps now go with each test's TMPDIR.

What was not yet known: a whole `bin/devbin test all` at the tip, 3241 arms with TMPDIR an empty directory, left nothing at its top, so whatever wrote node-compile-cache and the other entries now writes under a test's own TMPDIR. The run does not name that writer, and nothing here depends on it.

The arm in releasecore.bats: a remote call killed at its 1s bound (a pre-push hook that sleeps 20s) leaves nothing in its caller's TMPDIR, red at the base (it left devbin-git.*) and green at the tip. releasecut.bats's hung-query arm (ST0011 WP02b) now has its query list the arm's scratch directory by path, since inside a bounded call TMPDIR is the call's own, and counts devbin-call.* among the scratch that must be gone. Desk slot 01M7N79M7DJB05YRTAWJ2KGAQS: the named files (helpers, releasecore, clean, formula, upgradeoffer, updatenotice, heartbeat) green at the tip under GNU, test scans 61 of 61, check lint 0 breaches over 59 files, and test all 3240 of 3241, the one red that hung-query arm. Slot 01M7NDXNYYTHZ22ANR1HNY3EEM, after the arm's fix: releasecut.bats 232 of 232 under BSD and GNU, test scans 61 of 61, check lint 0 breaches. Each leg's TMPDIR was empty after it.
